correctness.rationale: Summing the geometric probability generating function for the maximum gives s_j=S(jλ) with λ=−log p. For y=1−e^(−u) and k=1−θ, multiplying the logarithmic derivative of the continuous hazard by y(1−y)(1−y^α)(1−ky^α)>0 gives E(y) as stated. Its decomposition A+kB proves strict increase for α≥1. For 0<α<1 the ordered coefficient signs are −,+,−,−,+ (at α=1/2 the two coinciding negative coefficients combine), so there are at most three positive roots counted with multiplicity. The generalized Descartes bound follows by induction after dividing by the lowest power and differentiating: Rolle bounds the root count by that of the derivative plus one, and when the first two coefficients have the same sign the derivative has an extra root before the first crossing or touch. The double root at y=1 leaves at most one interior zero. At θ=2α/(1+α), the quadratic term at 1 vanishes and the negative cubic makes the root triple. Together with E(0+)<0 and the endpoint expansion this gives the strict continuous classifications including equality. For a bathtub r, the derivative of the moving-bin integral is λ[r((x+1)λ)−r(xλ)]; its sign crosses at most once because on an interval straddling the continuous minimum the first term rises and the second falls. At most one integer increment can straddle the integrated-hazard minimum, yielding the strict adjacent comparisons and possible one tie. Multiplication by positive denominators gives s_1²−s_2 the sign of R. For H(λ)=log(S(λ)²/S(2λ)), H′=2[r(2λ)−r(λ)] has exactly one change from negative to positive. H starts at 0 and ends at log(α/θ). In particular at θ=α the increasing branch tends to zero from below; for θ<α there is exactly one positive crossing. Reversing λ to p gives the stated sides of the threshold.
residual_risks: Only interior parameters and a fixed equal-bin lattice are covered; numerical deep-tail tolerance does not prove the strict tail signs.

Known continuous phase theorem and known UGDGE hazard formula
value.rationale: The exact test decides an infinite failure-probability sequence using its first two entries in the eligible phase, and establishes precisely when sampling masks a continuous bathtub. The distinction at θ=α matters even though the continuous hazard at fixed α has no separate shape boundary there. This is a natural complete classification for an established reliability law, not merely a changed parametrization of its embedding.
residual_risks: This does not give threshold estimation or guarantees under noise or irregular bins.
